title: Polite Greetings and Titles with Benny

scenes.description: Waving to Mr. Green and Mrs. White in the Morning Street
Greeting Sir and Ma'am with Polite Smiles in the Library
Benny and Cheerful Boys and Girls Playing in the Courtyard

character_line.en: Look, our friendly neighbor is walking by! How should we greet him?
character_line.zh: 看，我們親切的鄰居正走過來！我們該怎麼跟他打招呼呢？

options.en: Good morning, Mr. Green! How are you?

options.hint: 對成年男士稱呼「Mr.（先生）」有禮貌地打招呼喔！
叫出鄰居格林先生的名字「Mr. Green」道早安喔！

character_line.en: And who is that kind lady with the lovely flowers?
character_line.zh: 那捧著美麗花朵的親切女士是誰呢？

options.en: That is Mrs. White! She is so nice!
options.zh: 那是懷特太太！她為人非常親切！

options.hint: 稱呼已婚女士用「Mrs.（太太/女士）」喔！
告訴 Benny 那位拿花的是懷特太太「Mrs. White」喔！

character_line.en: We are at the quiet library desk! What polite title can we use for the librarian?
character_line.zh: 我們來到安靜的圖書館借書櫃台！對男館員可以使用什麼禮貌稱呼呢？

options.en: Excuse me, Sir, may I borrow this book?
options.zh: 不好意思，先生，我可以借這本書嗎？

options.hint: 在正式場合禮貌尊稱先生可以用「Sir」喔！
很有禮貌地說「Excuse me, Sir」詢問借書喔！

character_line.en: And when the lady librarian helps us find books, how do we thank her?
character_line.zh: 當女館員幫我們找到繪本時，我們要怎麼向她道謝呢？

options.hint: 禮貌尊稱女士可以用「Ma'am」道謝喔！
向親切的館員女士道謝，說「Thank you, Ma'am」喔！

character_line.en: Here are all our friendly classmates in the courtyard! What are their names?
character_line.zh: 中庭裡有我們好多熱情的同班同學！他們的名字是什麼呢？

options.en: This is Tom, and that is Amy!

options.hint: 向 Benny 介紹同學的名字「This is Tom...」喔！
開心介紹身邊的小夥伴給 Benny 認識吧！

character_line.en: Being polite makes everyone happy! Let's always use kind words!
character_line.zh: 有禮貌讓大家都好開心！讓我們常常說親切的好話吧！

options.en: Yes! Polite words make the world sweeter!
options.zh: 沒錯！有禮貌的話語讓世界更美好！

options.hint: 贊同禮貌用語讓大家都很溫暖「Polite words make...」喔！
跟 Benny 一起約定做個有禮貌的好孩子吧！
